scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @lupinum/board-core build && pnpm --filter @lupinum/board-history --filter @lupinum/vue-board -r build && pnpm --filter @lupinum/board-connections build && pnpm --filter @lupinum/nuxt-board build
scripts.docs:build: pnpm docs:theme && pnpm build:packages && pnpm build:docs
scripts.release:version: changeset version && pnpm changelog && prettier CHANGELOG.md --write
scripts.test:docs: pnpm docs:theme && pnpm --filter docs typecheck && pnpm --filter docs build
scripts.test:unit: vitest run --exclude packages/nuxt-board/test/basic.test.ts --exclude packages/nuxt-board/test/prefixed.test.ts && pnpm --filter @lupinum/nuxt-board test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm typecheck:workspace && pnpm --filter docs typecheck && pnpm --filter @lupinum/nuxt-board test:types
scripts.verify:library: pnpm --filter docs exec nuxt prepare && pnpm typecheck:workspace && pnpm --filter @lupinum/nuxt-board test:types && pnpm test:unit && pnpm pack:check
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm check:vercel && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:unit && pnpm pack:check && pnpm test:docs
scripts.release:verify: pnpm audit:all && pnpm verify && pnpm test:e2e:functional && pnpm test:release-policy && pnpm release:notes:check && pnpm release:pack
